review:
Oodles of Noodles is a 5x3 Asian food slot with a conveyor belt of five noodle bowls under the reels, each holding a random prize or free spins value. When the panda lands, he collects all five bowls.

Every win removes the lowest-paying symbol and triggers a respin, and seven consecutive respins trigger free spins. Multipliers up to 10x appear in the bonus. Pragmatic Play states wins up to 5,100x. The RTP of 96.58% is among the best in this batch. The respin chain is a fun idea: each win makes the next more valuable.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
